decks.summary: Guide Marion who punches with One-Two Punch, Glory and Improvised Weapon, chains events through The Book of War and Tetsuo Mori, and recurs A Glimmer of Hope for cheap triggers.
Field Agent Marion who replays Soothing Melody from a Hallowed Mirror to heal her Field Agents for testless clues, fighting with Blessed Blade and Machete; solo and multiplayer.
Quick-rig flex Marion on events and skills, recycling A Glimmer of Hope, Scrounge for Supplies and Pushed to the Limit, with Blessed Blade, Mk 1 Grenades and Enchant Weapon for damage.
Gunbit Marion who plays, discards and replays Remington Model 1858 for free shots, using Prepared for the Worst, Act of Desperation and Pushed to the Limit to keep it cycling.
Soul Sanctification Marion who turns Second Wind, Ready for Anything and Soothing Melody into tempo, soaking with Spiritual Resolve and fighting with Fire Axe, Hunter's Mark and Sweeping Kick.
Cluever Marion who discards A Glimmer of Hope and Winging It to Reliable-upgraded Nautical Charts for two to four clues a round, with Alice Luxley and Scene of the Crime.
Hard Drowned City Marion at 3 XP who hunts with On the Hunt, Toe to Toe, Dynamite Blast and Sweeping Kick, backed by Machetes, Guard Dogs and a long campaign guide.
Wizard Marion whose Book of War returns Tactic events like One-Two Punch, Counterpunch and Glory, with Brand of Cthugha to fight and a Tinkered Crowbar for spare clues.
Double-and-Bold Marion who plays Bank Job, Task Force and Toe to Toe as her first action for the bonus, cycling Remingtons and Books of War with Act of Desperation.
Level 0 Gambit Marion built to pair with a cluever George, kicking the door in with Kicking the Hornet's Nest, One-Two Punch and Clean Them Out and stabbing with a Machete.
